dashboard.title: The work that needs your attention.
dashboard.intro: Respond to open questions, follow active work and see what is expected next.
dashboard.noAttention: Nothing is waiting on you right now.
dashboard.informationNeeded: SDK is waiting for more information.
dashboard.nextDefault: Create a request when you have a problem, constraint or project to discuss.

requests.title: Bring the problem and the context.
requests.intro: Save a draft, review the details and submit when the request is ready for SDK.
requests.emptyBody: Create a request to start a structured conversation with SDK.

form.title: Request title
form.supportingLinks: Supporting links — one HTTP(S) URL per line

operations.title: Request operations
operations.intro: Choose a company, review its requests and record the next decision.
operations.none: No request operations are available for your role.

profile.title: Your profile and access.
profile.intro: Review the identity Auth0 provides and the application access assigned to you.
profile.identityNote: Your name, email, avatar and security settings are managed by Auth0. Contact your administrator if an identity detail needs to change.

users.title: Give each person the access they need.
users.intro: Invite people, review current assignments and revoke application access without changing their Auth0 identity.
users.inviteToAssign: Send an invitation to assign this user.
users.accessCodeHelp: Share this code with anyone who should join this company without an invitation.

invitation.title: Review your invitation.
invitation.intro: You have been invited to {destination} as {role}.
invitation.email: Sign in with {email} and confirm to receive access.
invitation.mismatch: This invitation is for {invited}, but you are signed in as {signedin}. Sign out and switch to the invited account.
invitation.unavailableTitle: This invitation is no longer available.
invitation.unavailableBody: The link may have expired, been revoked or already been used. Ask the person who invited you to send a new one.
invitation.unavailableExpired: This invitation expired on {date}. Ask the person who invited you to send a new one.
invitation.unavailableRevoked: This invitation was revoked. Ask the person who invited you to send a new one.
invitation.unavailableUsed: This invitation has already been used. Ask the person who invited you to send a new one.

onboarding.title: Create your company workspace.
onboarding.intro: {email} is signed in and ready to start. Create a company to continue as its owner.
onboarding.name: Company name
onboarding.alternative: Joining an existing company instead? Ask its owner or administrator to invite this email address.
onboarding.accessTitle: Request access to an existing company.
onboarding.accessIntro: Enter the company access code you were given. A company owner or administrator reviews and approves the request.
